info.title: On Workflow Runner API
info.description: Control-plane, job, workflow, webhook, event, secret, artifact, and notification APIs. All application APIs are under /api/v1; /api is a compatibility alias. The OpenAPI document at /api/v1 is public. OIDC browser flows are handled separately. Active OIDC access tokens with the exact `admin` scope have platform-wide administrator authority on authenticated management APIs.

parameters.description: When true, limit results to enabled published workflows and return the active revision source.

patch.summary: Enable or disable a workflow without changing its publication state
patch.description: Requires workflows.edit in the selected workspace. This operation changes only the enabled flag and never creates a draft revision or publishes the workflow.

post.summary: Move an unexecuted workflow draft to another workspace
post.description: Requires workflows.edit in both the source workspace (X-Team-ID) and target workspace. Published or executed workflows cannot be transferred.

put.summary: Save a workflow draft through the scoped API
put.description: Requires an OIDC session or a bearer token with the workflows:write scope, plus the selected workspace. API keys are bound to their workspace; OIDC requests provide X-Team-ID. Saving a draft does not publish it.

oidcAdminSession.name: runner_oidc_session
oidcAdminSession.description: Requires an authenticated OIDC session with administrator role.

oidcAdminBearer.description: Platform-wide administrator access. Requires an active OIDC access token whose introspected scope contains the exact `admin` scope. This is a highly privileged automation credential.

WorkspaceId.name: X-Team-ID
WorkspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Required for OIDC sessions; API keys are restricted to their bound workspace.
